en.help.subheader: How can we help you today?
en.faq.card1: How do i buy a ticket?
en.faq.answer1: Navigate to the ticket purchase screen with the button through the home screen. Select what you need, and pay.
en.faq.card2: How do I plan a trip?
en.faq.answer2: Navigate to the route planner by using the button in the left sidebar.
en.faq.card3: I'd like to report a problem.
en.faq.card4: JI'd like to find the lost and found.
en.faq.answer4: Lost and founds are only available at the city centre, Brentwood and Marlborough Bus Depots. Call the number 403-262-1000 to get more information.
en.faq.card5: What are the fares and prices?
en.faq.answer5: Check fares through the ticket purchase. You will be able to back out should you decide not to purchase.
en.faq.card6: I want to contact Calgary Transit immediately.

fr.faq.card1: Comment est-ce je peut acheter des billets?

fr.faq.card2: Comment est-ce qu'on choisis une route?
fr.faq.answer2: Touchez le bouton 'Route' et navigez au ...
fr.faq.card4: J'ai besoin du bureau des objets trouvés.
fr.faq.answer4: Le service des objets trouvés est uniquement disponible au centre-ville et aux gares routières de Brentwood et de Marlborough. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez composer le 403-262-1000.
fr.faq.card5: Que sont les prix des billets?
fr.faq.answer5: Verifiiez les prix lors de votre achat d'un billet
